title: Turning the Lens Around: Bob Woodward Takes On Bob Woodward
summary: In a new memoir, the most celebrated journalist of his era finally tells his own story. It was “liberating,” he said in an interview. “Nothing is hidden here.”
body_markdown: In a new memoir, the most celebrated journalist of his era finally tells his own story. It was “liberating,” he said in an interview. “Nothing is hidden here.”
